standard_prerequisites.name: Weak decency of points over fields

standard_prerequisites.use: Weak decency of the fibre over a field.

core_obligations: Reduce to the fibre over a closed point; the fibre is an algebraic space over a field.
Bounded fibre degrees make the fibre quasi-finite over the field; weak decency identifies its points with scheme points.
Conclude the fibre is a finite disjoint union of spectra of fields finite over k.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the field fibre; quasi-finiteness; weak-decent identification.
difficulty_reason: A three-step reduction; the identification step is the substance.
